title: Five Places to Go in Lincoln, Neb.
abstract: The Nebraska capital’s downtown used to be considered rather sleepy. But with new watering holes and shops percolating, it’s become a pride of the plains.

title: Five Places to Shop in Arusha, Tanzania
abstract: For in-the-know locals and travelers alike, the downtown area is a place to linger and shop in a city known as a quick layover to safari destinations.
